//: Loops in generated maps (br-xlvx.6.4, R124), read by jj-procgen loops.rs. A loop takes a beat straight: `runInM` of straight road before its entry (the bots' approach and the player's run-up), the loop itself (its exit `runOutRadii` radii on along the road and `shiftM` to one side, the decks clearing each other), then `backM` over which the road eases back onto its line. `perLap` is how many a lap gets where its straights allow (not a cap on anything: a lap with more long straights could take more if this rises). `maxReliefM` is the deepest the ground may be cut to clear the deck (never below the ramp from its entry to its exit; dips are left, the loop stands over them). The deck's own sizes (`thicknessM`, `barrierHeightM`, `barrierWidthM`, `segments`) and `minSpeedMps` (carried round only above it) are the loop contract's params (jj-map looping). Nothing here caps anything.
